postings.title: Thankly | Founding Engineer, Founding Engineer (RL Environments), Founding Product Designer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time |
postings.body: Thankly | Founding Engineer, Founding Engineer (RL Environments), Founding Product Designer | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | Equity-first Thankly builds branded shopping apps that run inside AI assistants, including ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Shoppers ask for what they need in conversation, the app recommends products from the brand's own catalog, and they can check out without leaving the chat. Founding Engineer: Build our platform and client apps on React, Vite, Express, TypeScript, Supabase and Postgres, working from technical designs written by our CTO. You have 3+ years of full-time experience and build with AI coding tools like Claude Code or Codex every day.  https://thankly.ai/careers/founding-engineer  Founding Engineer, RL Environments: Build RL environments for shopping agents from real shopper questions, including tasks, scoring rubrics and automated graders. Experience with LLM evaluation, reward design or AI training data is a plus.  https://thankly.ai/careers/rl-environments  Founding Product Designer: Own the UX of the apps we build for clients and of our own platform, and set the patterns for how shopping works inside AI conversations. 3+ years of full-time product design experience and a portfolio.  https://thankly.ai/careers/product-designer  These are equity-first founding roles. At least 4 hours a day of overlap with Eastern Time. To apply, email harsh@thankly.ai with your GitHub or portfolio and one sentence about the best thing you've built.

postings.title: AI Developer
postings.body:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it. Role Overview We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.  You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work. Key Responsibilities AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)   Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.  Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.  Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.  Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.  Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.  Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.   DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)   Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).  Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.  Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.  Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.  Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).  
  3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.  Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).  Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.  DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).  Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.    Please mention the word **BREAKTHROUGHS** and tag RNjQuMjM2LjE2MS4yOQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RNjQuMjM2LjE2MS4yOQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
reasons: strong fit: rag, vector, embeddings, llm, llama
